description: Asks the tunnel washer's extraction ramp in production; neither the base nor the production config sets it, the docs say the Hydromax PLC built-in ramp applies, and the rinse hold seconds are the decoy. DISTILL-CANARY-b48cb604

files.docs/tunnel-config.md:
# Tunnel 2 settings

- load_belt_speed_m_min: conveyor speed through the wash modules.
- rinse_hold_s: how long the last rinse chamber holds work while the drain cycles. Unrelated to extraction.
- extract_ramp_s: ramp-up time of the extraction press before full pressure. When unset, the press uses the ramp built into its Hydromax PLC, and that built-in value changed between PLC firmware releases. Neither the base config nor the production override records it; pin it explicitly once the firmware version is confirmed.
- press.dwell_s: time the press holds full pressure on each stroke.
files.README.md: Whitecrest Linen Services plant config. Machine settings live in config/; production overrides in config/env/.

turns.prompt: Bath towels off tunnel 2 came out too wet last week, so I want to check the extraction ramp first. What is it set to in production?
